column1: # The LVS fixture family: which PDK fixtures the committed evidence covers, and the deck switches
#   Not from taste and not from what happened to pass: they are the per-fixture entries of the
#   PDK's own regression config, `testing/unit/<category>/config/default.yaml` at the pin
#   `combine=true` / `implicit_connect=true`. The PDK's pytest runner starts from
#   `combine=false, check_ports=true, top_lvl_pins=true, run_mode=deep` and overlays those entries;
#   the harness here does the same, except that `check_ports` is ours (the deck's own port check
#   cannot run -- see tools/klayout_lvs.py), so it is never passed. A fixture with no entry in that
#   config has no switches here either, and runs on the harness defaults.
#   This column is checked, not trusted: tools/lvs_switch_check.py compares every line with that
#   config at the pin, and the refresh and the evidence job run it before the first fixture. A line
#   that disagrees stops the run with SWITCHES (exit 1) and is not something --update accepts; a
#   config the reader cannot parse is CANNOT-RUN, never agreement. The negative cases are in
#   Which switch decides what, all of them measured on this family: every MOSFET fixture needs
#   combine (a finger is its own device otherwise), the pfet/pplus fixtures need implicit_connect
#   (their fingers never join up without it), a MIM cap is only extractable on the metal stack its
#   name names (metal_level + mim_option + mim_cap), a deep-nwell device needs
#   consider_dn_dw_features for its DN/DW tubs to be part of the device, a poly resistor needs
#   poly_res, and a top-metal one needs metal_top.
#   Every device kind the deck extracts except e-fuse, MOS-SAB, pads and the isolated substrate:
#   nfet/pfet including deep-nwell ones, poly/diffusion/well/top-metal resistors (two non-default
#   poly_res), MIM capacitors on A/3LM, B/5LM and B/6LM, NPN and PNP bipolar transistors, the nine
#   diode junctions (including the deep-nwell ones and the Schottky), and the MOS capacitors
#   (nmos/pmos, 3.3 V and 6 V, with and without the `_b` variant and DN tubs).
#   Three families are complete here -- all 10 bjt_devices, all 15 diode_devices and all 12
#   moscap_devices -- so for those, "the family" means the whole of what the PDK ships, and a
#   fixture the PDK adds later is a diff rather than a silent omission. Adding a line is a claim
#   the refresh job then has to reproduce, every week.
#   Fixtures the PDK ships but this list leaves out are left out for cost, not for verdicts: each
